title: Nervous About Economic DOOM
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: Tech sector PMI 62.7, fastest growth since 2021; economy booming on AI spend.
Stay bullish as long as the labor market (improving 3-6 month payroll trends) and AI underwriters (OpenAI, Anthropic) hold up.
10y ~5.32% is ~5bp above where he'd like it to stop; 2s10s near 50bp 'shock territory' and widening high-yield spreads raise risk; be cautious/nervous, not fearful.
Hedge equity risk through allocation to cash, real estate, private equity and debt payoff rather than timing a black swan.
